content: Given the limitations of static word embeddings, recent work has tried to create context-sensitive word representations. ELMo BIBREF2, BERT BIBREF3, and GPT-2 BIBREF9 are deep neural language models that are fine-tuned to create models for a wide range of downstream NLP tasks. Their internal representations of words are called contextualized word representations because they are a function of the entire input sentence. The success of this approach suggests that these representations capture highly transferable and task-agnostic properties of language BIBREF4.
